desc: A great addition to your range bag, the Target Stapler from Birchwood Casey is a 3-in-1 staple gun with adjustable driving force. Since 1948, serious shooters, avid collectors and professional gunsmiths have relied on Birchwood Casey for shooting and gun care products that have stood the test of time. Birchwood Casey has pioneered innovative products with an unwavering dedication for quality.
